|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Chewie With Blaster Rifle (V)]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[Chewie With Blaster Rifle (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

Permanent weapon is Blaster Rifle (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 &gt; defense value).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Chewie With Blaster Rifle (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 25]] (8 August 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114001541/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref>, page 7, file created 10 August 2025: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While with a captive, droid, or opponent's [Maintenance] card, adds one battle destiny. Permanent weapon is Blaster Rifle (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 &gt; defense value).” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Chewie With Blaster Rifle (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Chewie With Blaster Rifle”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Chewie With Blaster Rifle (V)]] (published 7 August 2025) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Chewie With Blaster Rifle]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
